strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『先不要急着高兴,阿金。{NEWLINE}如果不在这里打倒坂木,{CLEAR}那么咱们的未来生活就只是一个幻想。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t get too excited yet,{NEWLINE}Gold.{SCROLL}If we don’t take down Giovanni here,{NEWLINE}our future together is just a fantasy.

strings.zh: 阿金『我明白,万恶之源火箭队嘛。{NEWLINE}我这就冲上石英高原,{CLEAR}狠狠地修理一下坂木那个老混蛋。
strings.en: Gold: I get it. Team Rocket, the root of{NEWLINE}all evil.{SCROLL}I’m charging up to the Indigo Plateau{NEWLINE}right now to give that old bastard{CLEAR}Giovanni a good thrashing!
Silver: {VAR:0103:0}... Big Sis...
strings.notes: Silver calls the player 姐姐 for the first time; kept as 'Big Sis' because #207 comments on it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『怎么了小银？{NEWLINE}你这还是第一次叫我姐姐呢。{CLEAR}毕竟你以前都是叫我{CLEAR}混蛋冠军、笨蛋冠军什么的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What’s wrong, Silver?{SCROLL}That’s the first time you’ve ever called{NEWLINE}me Big Sis.{SCROLL}You always used to call me stuff like{NEWLINE}bastard Champion or stupid Champion.
strings.notes: RV020: softened: 混蛋冠军 'bastard Champion', as in a027/0126#80

strings.zh: 小银『那个……那个是我以前不懂事。{NEWLINE}刚才{VAR:0103:0}姐姐在小绿馆主面{CLEAR}前替我据理力争,{CLEAR}让我有了一种被拉到阳光下的感觉。{CLEAR}不、不只是这一次,{CLEAR}在阿鲁夫遗迹、在烧焦塔、在卡吉镇,{CLEAR}其实从那时候开始,{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}姐姐你就在努力{CLEAR}让我摆脱火箭队的阴影,{CLEAR}让我可以不用再东躲西藏,{CLEAR}让我不用再以生为坂木的儿子而自卑……
strings.en: Silver: That... That was me being{NEWLINE}immature.{SCROLL}Just now, you stood up for me in front{NEWLINE}of Gym Leader Blue, Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}...{SCROLL}It felt like I’d been pulled out into the{NEWLINE}sunlight.{SCROLL}N-not just this time. At the Ruins of{NEWLINE}Alph, the Burned Tower, Mahogany{CLEAR}Town... Ever since back then...{SCROLL}You’ve worked to free me from Team{NEWLINE}Rocket’s shadow, Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}...{SCROLL}So I wouldn’t have to hide anymore, and{NEWLINE}wouldn’t have to feel ashamed of being{CLEAR}born Giovanni’s son...
strings.notes: RV020: voice: 姐姐 kept as 'Big Sis ⟨player⟩' after #206/#207, as in a027/0126 (D-2099)

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Silver...

strings.zh: 小银『我本该早就意识到的,{NEWLINE}但是直到今天面临生死决战,{CLEAR}我才敢坦然地面对自己的内心,{CLEAR}我、我喜欢{VAR:0103:0}你,{CLEAR}是那种我愿意倾尽一生{CLEAR}去珍惜、守护的喜欢！
strings.en: Silver: I should have realized it long{NEWLINE}ago.{SCROLL}But only today, facing a life-or-death{NEWLINE}battle, can I face my own heart.{SCROLL}I... I love you, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}The kind of love I’d spend my whole life{NEWLINE}cherishing and protecting!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没想到我们原本嘴硬的小银,{NEWLINE}也能说出这样的话来。{CLEAR}足以见得这份喜欢是多么沉重了。{CLEAR}我会好好珍惜你的这份心意的。{CLEAR}然后这是我的心意,{CLEAR}也请你收下吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Who’d have thought our{NEWLINE}stubborn Silver could say that? It{CLEAR}shows how deep your feelings run.{SCROLL}I’ll treasure them. And here are my{NEWLINE}feelings, too. Please accept them!

strings.zh: 小银『谢、谢谢{VAR:0103:0}姐姐！{NEWLINE}我、我会用生命守护你的！
strings.en: Silver: Th-thank you, Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}I-I’ll protect you with my life!
strings.notes: RV020: voice: 姐姐 kept as 'Big Sis ⟨player⟩' (D-2099)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『需要守护的可不只是我哦,{NEWLINE}而是被火箭队盯上的整个地区。{CLEAR}所以咱们一起去石英高原吧,{CLEAR}赌上一切守护这个地区！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s not just me that needs{NEWLINE}protecting. It’s the whole region Team{CLEAR}Rocket has its sights on.{SCROLL}So let’s go to the Indigo Plateau{NEWLINE}together, and stake everything on{CLEAR}protecting this region!

strings.zh: 小银『好的,{VAR:0103:0}姐姐！{NEWLINE}咱们出发！
strings.en: Silver: Right, Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}Let’s go!
strings.notes: RV020: voice: 姐姐 kept as 'Big Sis ⟨player⟩' (D-2099)

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈！请等一等！
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}! Please wait!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『有什么事吗,水晶？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What is it, Crystal?

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈……{NEWLINE}这场战斗或许真的非常危险,{CLEAR}所以我担心有些话如果现在不说,{CLEAR}以后可能就没机会说了。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}... This battle could{NEWLINE}be really dangerous.{SCROLL}So I’m worried that if I don’t say some{NEWLINE}things now,{SCROLL}I might never get the chance.
{VAR:0103:0}: Crystal...

strings.zh: 水晶『我记得在吉野市{NEWLINE}初次跟前辈见面时,{CLEAR}前辈在孤儿院跟孩子们{CLEAR}畅谈自己旅行的经历,{CLEAR}而我坐在旁边静静地听着。{CLEAR}仿佛就像是……像是……{CLEAR}像是一位慈祥的父亲{CLEAR}给自己的孩子们讲故事一样。
strings.en: Crystal: I remember the first time I met{NEWLINE}you, in Cherrygrove City.{SCROLL}You were at the orphanage, telling the{NEWLINE}children all about your travels, and I{CLEAR}sat beside you, quietly listening.{SCROLL}It was just like... like...{SCROLL}Like a kind father telling stories to his{NEWLINE}children.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『原来我在水晶的心目中{NEWLINE}是老父亲的形象啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So in your eyes I’m an old dad,{NEWLINE}Crystal?

strings.zh: 水晶『不、不是的！我的意思是说,{NEWLINE}我希望我未来孩子的父亲,{CLEAR}能够像前辈一样温柔又强大！
strings.en: Crystal: N-no, that’s not it! What I{NEWLINE}mean is...{SCROLL}I hope the father of my future children{NEWLINE}will be kind and strong, just like you!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你对我的评价,{NEWLINE}水晶你也是个非常温柔的女孩子哦。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thanks for saying that.{NEWLINE}You’re a really kind girl too, Crystal.

strings.zh: 水晶『谢谢前辈的夸奖……{NEWLINE}其实我在跟前辈的旅行中,{CLEAR}不断地感受着前辈{CLEAR}如阳光般温暖的气息,{CLEAR}但是在烟墨市跟前辈告别之后,{CLEAR}我就像失去了阳光的向日葵,{CLEAR}完全不知道自己该看向哪里。{CLEAR}今天好不容易又一次跟前辈见面了,{CLEAR}我想直面曾经照耀自己的太阳,{CLEAR}告诉前辈您——{CLEAR}我喜欢你,{VAR:0103:0}前辈！
strings.en: Crystal: Thank you... The truth is,{NEWLINE}traveling with you, I kept feeling your{CLEAR}warmth, like sunshine.{SCROLL}But after we said goodbye in Blackthorn{NEWLINE}City, I was like a sunflower without the{CLEAR}sun. I had no idea where to look.{SCROLL}Today I’ve finally gotten to see you{NEWLINE}again, and I want to face the sun that{CLEAR}once shone on me...{SCROLL}And tell you... I love you, {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『能被水晶你这样的女孩喜欢,{NEWLINE}我真的很高兴。{CLEAR}如果我孩子的妈妈是水晶的话,{CLEAR}想必我也会很幸福吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m really happy that a girl{NEWLINE}like you loves me, Crystal.{SCROLL}If the mother of my children were you,{NEWLINE}I’m sure I’d be very happy too.

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈……！
strings.en: Crystal: Oh...!
strings.notes: 前辈 (senpai) dropped in Crystal's lines; the player's name is used where the zh has the tag.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『接下来的战斗会非常激烈,{NEWLINE}无论如何请保护好自己,好吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The battle ahead will be{NEWLINE}fierce. Whatever happens, please look{CLEAR}after yourself, OK?

strings.zh: 水晶『好的前辈！
strings.en: Crystal: I will!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,大家都已经进山洞了,{NEWLINE}咱们也出发吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Everyone’s already gone into{NEWLINE}the cave. Let’s go too!
Misty: {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小霞？{NEWLINE}你不是应该在华蓝市镇守吗？{CLEAR}怎么到这儿来了？{CLEAR}是华蓝市出什么事了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Misty? Aren’t you supposed to{NEWLINE}be guarding Cerulean City?{SCROLL}What are you doing here? Did something{NEWLINE}happen in Cerulean?

strings.zh: 小霞『不,华蓝市没什么事。{NEWLINE}我是担心你,所以到这儿来看看。
strings.en: Misty: No, Cerulean’s fine.{SCROLL}I was worried about you, so I came to{NEWLINE}check on you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你,小霞。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thanks, Misty.

strings.zh: 小霞『真是的,你就只会说谢谢吗？{NEWLINE}现在大战在即,{CLEAR}你就没有什么想对我说的吗？
strings.en: Misty: Honestly, is thanks all you can{NEWLINE}say?{SCROLL}The big battle’s about to start. Isn’t{NEWLINE}there anything you want to tell me?

strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s)

strings.zh: 小霞『唉,你还是老样子。{NEWLINE}不过谁让我喜欢的就是这样的你呢。
strings.en: Misty: Sigh, you haven’t changed a bit.{SCROLL}But I guess that’s exactly the you I{NEWLINE}fell for.
{VAR:0103:0}: You... like me?
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s)

strings.zh: 小霞『咱们第一次在湖边相遇时,{NEWLINE}我就觉得眼前这个男生有点点小帅,{CLEAR}后来在月见山面对暴走的暴鲤龙、{CLEAR}面对强大的火箭队,{CLEAR}你的鼓励让我感到无比温暖。{CLEAR}在华蓝海角跟你比赛、{CLEAR}在电脑世界跟你并肩作战,{CLEAR}这都是我无法忘记的美好回忆。{CLEAR}后来无论是在彩虹市大战火箭队,{CLEAR}还是一起去双子岛追回蓝色宝珠。{CLEAR}你都让我感觉你无比值得信赖,{CLEAR}我让我感觉自己越来越离不开你……
strings.en: Misty: When we first met by the lake, I{NEWLINE}thought you were kind of cute.{SCROLL}Later at Mt. Moon, facing a raging{NEWLINE}Gyarados and Team Rocket...{SCROLL}Your encouragement made me feel so{NEWLINE}warm.{SCROLL}Battling you at Cerulean Cape, fighting{NEWLINE}side by side in the computer world...{SCROLL}Those are wonderful memories I’ll never{NEWLINE}forget.{SCROLL}Then there was fighting Team Rocket in{NEWLINE}Celadon City, and chasing the Blue Orb{CLEAR}together to the Seafoam Islands.{SCROLL}Every time, you made me feel I could{NEWLINE}trust you completely...{SCROLL}And I found I needed you more and{NEWLINE}more...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s)
v3 TM: 1 source(s)

strings.zh: 小霞『一想到{VAR:0103:0}要登上石英高原{NEWLINE}与火箭队决战,{CLEAR}我的心里就忍不住地担心。{CLEAR}我知道如今的你{CLEAR}已经是无比强大的训练家,{CLEAR}但我却前所未有地担心你。{CLEAR}我的心似乎已经{CLEAR}与你紧紧地绑在一起了,{CLEAR}这种感觉,大概就是喜欢吧……
strings.en: Misty: Whenever I think of you heading{NEWLINE}up to the Indigo Plateau for the final{CLEAR}battle with Team Rocket, {VAR:0103:0}...{SCROLL}I can’t help worrying.{SCROLL}I know you’re an incredibly strong{NEWLINE}Trainer now, but I’ve never been this{CLEAR}worried about you.{SCROLL}It’s like my heart is tied tightly to{NEWLINE}yours.{SCROLL}I guess this feeling... is love...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), flags var_mismatch | seed rejected tm_v3 [tag_mismatch] (candidate v3 0462#209; text not kept)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你,小霞……{NEWLINE}咱们确实一起经历了太多太多。{CLEAR}我对你的感情也早从最初的伙伴,{CLEAR}变成了心底无法割舍的那个女孩。{CLEAR}其实我早该开口告诉你的,{CLEAR}我喜欢你,小霞……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thank you, Misty...{SCROLL}We really have been through so, so much{NEWLINE}together.{SCROLL}My feelings for you changed long ago,{NEWLINE}from a travel companion to the girl I{CLEAR}can’t bear to lose.{SCROLL}I should have told you a long time ago.{NEWLINE}I love you, Misty...

strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s)

strings.zh: 小霞『能的到你的回应,我真的好开心。
strings.en: Misty: Hearing you say that makes me so{NEWLINE}happy.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我现在必须要去石英高原{NEWLINE}跟火箭队决战了,{CLEAR}小霞也快回华蓝市{CLEAR}做好城市的防卫工作吧。{CLEAR}等打败了火箭队,我就去华蓝市找你。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I have to head to the Indigo{NEWLINE}Plateau now to face Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Misty, you should hurry back to{NEWLINE}Cerulean City and look after its{CLEAR}defense.{SCROLL}Once we’ve beaten Team Rocket, I’ll{NEWLINE}come find you in Cerulean City.

strings.zh: 小霞『嗯,我要看你平平安安地回来哦,{NEWLINE}要是少了一根头发,我可不饶你。
strings.en: Misty: OK. I want to see you come back{NEWLINE}safe and sound.{SCROLL}If you lose even a single hair, I won’t{NEWLINE}forgive you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哈哈,没问题,我答应你！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ha ha, no problem. I promise!

strings.zh: 小霞『那我现在要回去了,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}你保重啊！
strings.en: Misty: I’m heading back now. Take care,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 大木博士『啊,现在的年轻人,真是不得了！
strings.en: Prof. Oak: Ah, young people these{NEWLINE}days... They’re really something!

strings.zh: 大木博士『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}这既然是口袋妖怪能力造成的屏障,{CLEAR}那么就应该可以{CLEAR}被口袋妖怪的能力给破坏掉。{CLEAR}现在咱们有这么多训练家在这里,{CLEAR}如果集中所有人的精灵攻击屏障,{CLEAR}说不定能强行把屏障打破。
strings.en: Prof. Oak: {VAR:0103:0}, if this barrier was{NEWLINE}created by a Pokémon’s power,{SCROLL}then a Pokémon’s power should be able{NEWLINE}to destroy it.{SCROLL}We have so many Trainers here now.{SCROLL}If everyone’s Pokémon attack the{NEWLINE}barrier together, we just might break{CLEAR}through by force.

strings.zh: 众人『太好了！终于成功了！
strings.en: Everyone: Yes! We finally did it!

strings.zh: 众人『哦哦哦哦哦！！！冠军大人！！！
strings.en: Everyone: Whoooa!!! Champion!!!

strings.zh: 精灵联盟与火箭队正面冲突,{NEWLINE}这可是不得了的大事。{CLEAR}我得加强这里的警戒才行。
strings.en: The Pokémon League clashing head-on{NEWLINE}with Team Rocket... This is huge.{SCROLL}I’d better tighten security here.

strings.zh: 感谢所有人的共同努力,{NEWLINE}火箭队终于被彻底打败了。{CLEAR}这下又可以安心过太平日子了。
strings.en: Thanks to everyone, Team Rocket has{NEWLINE}finally been beaten for good.{SCROLL}Now we can live in peace again.

strings.zh: 风速狗『Arrrrr——ca！
strings.en: Arcanine: Arrrrr-ca!

strings.zh: 叶精灵『Leeeee——feo！
strings.en: Leafeon: Leeeee-feo!

strings.en: Rhydon: Rhyyyy-don!
